import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Check for missing values in the invasion_success dataset
missing_values = invasion_success.isnull().sum()
missing_values

# Analyze the relationship between introduction pathways and mrt
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='mrt', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Boxplot of Minimum Residence Time by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.show()

# Perform an ANOVA to test for significant differences in mrt across introduction pathways
model = sm.OLS(invasion_success['mrt'], sm.add_constant(invasion_success['intro.pathway'].astype('category').cat.codes))
results = model.fit()
anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(results, typ=2)
anova_table

import scipy.stats as stats

# Perform ANOVA using scipy.stats
groups = [invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == pathway]['mrt'] for pathway in invasion_success['intro.pathway'].unique()]
f_statistic, p_value = stats.f_oneway(*groups)
f_statistic, p_value

# Analyze the relationship between introduction pathways and number of invaded plots
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='number.of.invaded.plots', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Boxplot of Number of Invaded Plots by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.show()

# Analyze the relationship between introduction pathways and area of occupancy
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='area.of.occupancy.10km', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Boxplot of Area of Occupancy by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Area of Occupancy (10 km scale)')
plt.show()

# Analyze the relationship between introduction pathways and invaded niche breadth
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='invaded.niche.breadth', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Boxplot of Invaded Niche Breadth by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.show()

# Perform ANOVA for number of invaded plots
groups_number_plots = [invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == pathway]['number.of.invaded.plots'] for pathway in invasion_success['intro.pathway'].unique()]
f_statistic_number_plots, p_value_number_plots = stats.f_oneway(*groups_number_plots)
f_statistic_number_plots, p_value_number_plots

# Perform ANOVA for area of occupancy
groups_area_occupancy = [invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == pathway]['area.of.occupancy.10km'] for pathway in invasion_success['intro.pathway'].unique()]
f_statistic_area_occupancy, p_value_area_occupancy = stats.f_oneway(*groups_area_occupancy)
f_statistic_area_occupancy, p_value_area_occupancy

# Perform ANOVA for invaded niche breadth
groups_niche_breadth = [invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == pathway]['invaded.niche.breadth'] for pathway in invasion_success['intro.pathway'].unique()]
f_statistic_niche_breadth, p_value_niche_breadth = stats.f_oneway(*groups_niche_breadth)
f_statistic_niche_breadth, p_value_niche_breadth

# Analyze the relationship between mrt and number of invaded plots
sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='number.of.invaded.plots', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Scatterplot of Minimum Residence Time vs. Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.show()

# Analyze the relationship between mrt and area of occupancy
sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='area.of.occupancy.10km', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Scatterplot of Minimum Residence Time vs. Area of Occupancy')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Area of Occupancy (10 km scale)')
plt.show()

# Analyze the relationship between mrt and invaded niche breadth
sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='invaded.niche.breadth', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Scatterplot of Minimum Residence Time vs. Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.show()

# Perform linear regression for mrt and number of invaded plots
X_mrt = invasion_success['mrt'].values.reshape(-1, 1)
y_number_plots = invasion_success['number.of.invaded.plots'].values

model_number_plots = stats.linregress(X_mrt, y_number_plots)
model_number_plots

# Perform linear regression for mrt and area of occupancy
y_area_occupancy = invasion_success['area.of.occupancy.10km'].values

model_area_occupancy = stats.linregress(X_mrt, y_area_occupancy)
model_area_occupancy

# Perform linear regression for mrt and invaded niche breadth
y_niche_breadth = invasion_success['invaded.niche.breadth'].values

model_niche_breadth = stats.linregress(X_mrt, y_niche_breadth)
model_niche_breadth
